'''Jyss Cordam''' worked as a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] for [[Byro Ti'mere]] at [[Ti'mere's InfoServices]].

==Biography==
Jyss Cordam was a [[Near-Human]] [[Unidentified wavy-eared species|alien]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who worked under [[Byro Ti'mere]] at [[Ti'mere's InfoServices]]. He was also one of the company's salesmen, and was InfoService's contact for corporate clients. Cordam's work led him to travel extensively throughout the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]], meeting new and existing clients and opening new contracts for those seeking InfoServices' assistance. His work also takes him regularly to [[Brugga]] in the [[Latoma system/Legends|Latoma system]] to talk with Ti'mere.<ref name="FBS" />

Cordam traveled aboard his personal [[SU 161 stock light freighter]], and was constantly accompanied by his [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], [[R2-L3/Legends|R2-L3]]. Due to the number of corporate [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on his head, R2-L3 records all discussions and transactions, as well as acting as a look-out in case of trouble.<ref name="FBS" />

==Personality and traits==
Cordam was a Near-Human of medium height, with curly, sand-colored [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. He possessed a relaxed smile and bright [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Cordam's had an outgoing and confident, energetic personality, that he used to deliver smooth sales pitches.<ref name="FBS" />

==Equipment==
Cordam always dressed in smart clothing. He carried a [[portable computer]] and [[computer spike]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="FBS" />
